design_decisions: Automatic runs do not use the M10 package-selection/export owners. PACKAGE and EXPORT build and re-verify a deterministic archive bound to the M10 PASS disposition receipt; the M10 owners stay Human-operated.
Automatic Quality can only issue PASS or REWORK dispositions; it can never waive.
Automatic owner variants exist only where a launch consumer needs them: Narrative/Canon/Plan, Gate A greenlight and Gate C master. M6 adaptation, Gate B ScriptLock and Gate D stay Human-only.

blockers.detail: A Human-labeled corpus of 40 finals (20 calibration + 20 hold-out, 10 clean + 10 critical-defect each) and two distinct local multimodal reviewer models. Only qwen3.5-vimax:9b and bge-m3 are installed. Run scripts/r2/qualify_reviewers.py --record per reviewer.
A published automatic Quality profile and a launch qualification record for a real project. Preflight refuses to start a run until both exist.
One real run on the GPU host through scripts/r2/qualify_autonomous_production.py, after the two blockers above are cleared.
The drama lip-sync route is unqualified, so drama launch stays blocked; narration is the only candidate launch profile.
